name: Tersia
shortDescription: A UK Christian-community app for groups, events, prayer, tickets and Stripe-connected fundraising, including parish and young-adult community use cases.
suitableContexts: Parishes and Christian communities coordinating events and fundraising
Groups wanting a community-facing mobile app rather than a full church database

pricing.summary: Tersia says it is free to set up and free for members to join communities and free events. It states that it charges a small platform fee on donations and paid events but does not publish the amount in the reviewed public material. Obtain current fee, VAT, payment, refund and payout terms before use.

tiers.label: Community setup and free events
tiers.detail: Supplier says communities can be set up free and free events remain free.

tiers.label: Donations and paid events
tiers.detail: Supplier states a platform fee applies but does not publish the amount on the reviewed page.

gdprInformation: Tersia publishes a privacy policy covering its website and app, including account, event and payment information, UK/EEA rights, and access/deletion requests. The policy does not identify the legal entity by company number in the reviewed material, nor establish detailed controller/processor roles, hosting locations, sub-processors, retention schedules or a DPA for church/group use. The published company record shows Tersia Limited was incorporated in June 2025, so early-stage supplier due diligence is especially important.
coreFeatures: Events, RSVPs, approvals, tickets and reminders
importExport: No current group-data import, export or deletion workflow was established beyond privacy-policy account-data rights
Obtain written information on migration, export, data access and deletion before using it for enduring community records
support: Supplier publishes email, telephone and London contact details
Confirm service hours, incident response and safeguarding escalation process before use

uk-operator.value: Companies House lists Tersia Limited, number 16497836, as an active England-and-Wales company incorporated in June 2025. The product site gives a London contact location.

church-community-workflow.value: Tersia describes communities including parishes, prayer groups and young-adult groups, combining event coordination, tickets, chat, prayer and fundraising.

payment-workflow.value: Supplier states that communities connect Stripe for payouts and can receive one-off and monthly donations and paid-event income.

privacy.value: Tersia publishes a privacy policy for its website and app with UK/EEA rights, account data, event data and payment-information handling.

editorial.assessment: Tersia is a community and fundraising app for Christian groups, not a conventional church-management database, Gift Aid system, accounting package or safeguarding case-management platform. It may suit a parish, fellowship or young-adult group that wants public discovery, events, prayer and Stripe-connected giving in one member-facing experience. Its recent incorporation and sparse public contractual detail make a limited pilot and written due diligence essential before loading a church’s main records or relying on it for finance administration.
bestFor: Christian communities coordinating events, prayer and basic fundraising
Parishes or groups seeking a public-facing community and discovery app
Groups that can operate a limited pilot before adopting it for core workflows
strengths: Specific Christian community and parish use cases
Events, tickets, prayer, chat and Stripe-connected giving are documented
Free setup and free-event use are stated
limitations: Recently incorporated supplier with limited public operational history
It is not a full church-management, accounting, Gift Aid or safeguarding system
The platform-fee amount, refunds, VAT, contract and payout detail are not published in the reviewed material
DPA, sub-processors, hosting, export, retention and exit information need written supplier evidence

procurementVerdict.problem: Helping a Christian community coordinate gatherings and raise money without stitching together many consumer tools
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK Christian-community app that connects events, prayer, chat, tickets and Stripe payouts
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run a small low-risk event pilot and obtain the current fee, refund, data-processing, retention, export, moderation and safeguarding terms before adopting it for ongoing group operations
